delete.description: Deletes a single file, or every object under a folder key. Type must be "file" or "folder". Deleting a folder synced from an external data source (or a folder containing one) also disconnects that data source; items INSIDE a synced folder cannot be deleted (409), and deletion is refused with 409 while an affected sync is running.

parameters.description: Node-relative key (folder keys may end with /)
parameters.name: key

post.description: Copies or moves a batch of files/folders (siblings from one folder level) into a destination directory, optionally in a different accessible business node. Both modes resolve name collisions with numeric " (2)" suffixes — nothing is overwritten. Moving a folder into itself or its own subtree is rejected. Nothing can be pasted INTO a folder synced from an external data source, and items inside a synced folder can be copied out but not moved (409). Partial failures return 200 with a failed list.

parameters.description: Source/destination nodes, path, mode and items
parameters.name: request

post.description: Returns the key an upload should use for the given file — unchanged when free, numerically suffixed ("a.pdf" → "a (2).pdf") when the name is already taken — plus a V4 signed PUT URL for exactly that key. PUT the file body to upload_url sending upload_headers verbatim: they carry an if-generation-match precondition (412 if the object appeared meanwhile — re-resolve and retry) and a content-length-range that GCS enforces on the actual received bytes (400 when over max_size_bytes). Called once per file right before its upload. Refused with 409 inside folders synced from an external data source.

parameters.description: Target directory and relative file key
parameters.name: request

put.description: Moves a file or folder (copy + delete) to a new key within the same business node. A folder move relocates every object under its prefix; the destination must not be inside the source, and a destination name that already exists is rejected with 409. Items inside a folder synced from an external data source cannot be renamed or moved, and nothing can move into one (409); renaming or moving the synced folder itself (or an ancestor) keeps its connection pointed at the new location.

force_file_type.description:
ForceFileType optionally overrides AI auto-detection ("erp" or "bom").
When set, the file is classified as that type and only that type's
column mappings are populated. Empty means auto-detect.

bom_artifacts.description:
BomArtifacts gates the conversational BOM Artifacts feature (portal
sidebar section + rag-agent endpoints). Enabled per-business via the admin
dev-features endpoint; consumed by the frontend's useBusinessDevFeatures.

bom_raw_import.description:
BomRawImport gates the dynamic BOM import (import every column as-is into
a first-class raw structure, no static mapping). Same flag the gateway
import handler checks server-side.

superseded_by.description: ID of the newer (superseding) item; only set when classification is "superseded"

pairs.description: List of item pairs to look up

pipeline_version.description:
PipelineVersion selects the item-handling flow. Empty (the default) is v1;
v2 callers send "v2" to opt into folder-mapping filtering + folder part
number + enrich-or-create. The backend requires a configured import folder
mapping for v2 and rejects the import otherwise.

business_node_id.description: BusinessNodeID is the business node (must be a leaf node) to associate imported documents with.

keys.description:
Keys are the object keys (paths) of files to import from the data sources bucket.
These are relative to the business's directory (e.g., "data-source-name/folder/file.pdf").

name.description: Name is an optional name for the import job.

replace_existing.description: ReplaceExisting if true will re-process documents with the same filename.

filenames.description:
Filenames to check import status for (full key paths relative to business root,
e.g. "datasource-uuid/subfolder/file.pdf"). These must match documents.filename in the DB.

statuses.description: Statuses maps filename → import status. Only files that have been imported are included.

page_number.description: Page number where table was found

table_index.description: Index of table on the page (0-based)

source_column.description: exact header text in the uploaded file == metadata key

unconsolidated_count.description:
UnconsolidatedCount is the number of ERP records whose primary identifier
appears exactly once in the node (not shared with any other record). It is
the inverse of the "duplicates" set and is computed with the same
NOT-EXISTS predicate as the `unconsolidated` list filter so the count
matches the filtered row set.

is_preferred.description: From the linked item (items.is_preferred), false when unmatched

replace_existing.description: Delete and re-process documents with same filename

force.description:
Force also retriggers documents in terminal success states
(spec_matched). Only honored together with an explicit DocumentIDs list —
a forced full-import rerun must stay impossible from this endpoint.

attributes.description:
Attributes carries every non-first-class column preserved from the upload
(dynamic import). Empty for legacy uploads made before dynamic mapping.

primary_identifier_name.description: Name fields for human-friendly display and llm

duplicate_percent.description: DuplicatePercent: % of ERP records that matched to items (duplicate detection).

merged_documents_count.description: MergedDocumentsCount: total source documents contributing to merged items.

merged_items_count.description: MergedItemsCount: number of items linked to more than one source document.

similar_threshold.description:
SimilarThreshold: the minimum similarity score used for counting similar items.
Defaults to 0.8 but may be overridden per business.

similarity_classes.description:
SimilarityClasses: per-class item counts for tenants on the classified
similarity taxonomy (duplicate, interchangeable_variant, superseded,
product_variant, related_parts, component_of). When present the frontend
renders one tile per class instead of the legacy duplicate/similar pair.

class_comparison.description:
Classified-taxonomy tenants: the pair classifier's verdict plus every
signal it compared (dimensions, attributes, specs, relationship). When
present the compare page renders this table instead of the (empty for
these tenants) legacy spec comparison.

internal_code.description: drawing internal code (Kacher-test); small identifier line

additional_data.description: Additional structured data (dynamic categories like assembly details, tolerances, etc.)

hs_code.description:
HSCode is the durable, authoritative human decision for this item's HS
code (a verified AI suggestion or a manual override), when one exists.
It survives AI re-classification and takes display precedence over the
suggestions above.

hs_code_suggestions.description:
HS code suggestions (customs classification)
IMPORTANT: These are AI-generated SUGGESTIONS only. We do not provide binding tariff rulings.
Final classification responsibility remains with the importer of record or their licensed customs broker.

is_preferred.description: Whether this item is flagged as a preferred part

item_validation.description:
Item Validation config (conditions + statements) for this item's business,
present only when the item_governance feature is enabled. The portal
evaluates it client-side and renders the failing statements; omitted when
the feature is disabled or unconfigured.

references.description: Reference identifiers (standards, cross-referenced part numbers, etc.)

source_documents.description: All linked source documents (from item_documents junction table)

confidence_score.description: carried over when verified; nil for override

image_signed_url.description: Time-limited signed HTTPS URL for frontend access

image_url.description: Original GCS URI (gs://...) to item image (from source document)

is_preferred.description: Item is flagged as a preferred part

text_snippet.description: Snippet from specs or OCR text

count.description: Number of like features (e.g., "4" identical holes); model-extract part-analysis

extracted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this spec was extracted

match_method.description: How spec was matched to canonical name

original_key.description: Attribute name in English (translated from raw_key if non-English)

original_value.description: Value in English (translated from raw_value if non-English)

provisional_canonical.description: True when matched candidate has no confirmed canonical_name yet

raw_key.description: Attribute name exactly as written in the document

raw_value.description: Value exactly as written in the document

rejected_match.description: LLM's suggestion when confidence was too low

similarity_relevant.description: Model's per-spec flag for which features drive part matching (model-extract)

source_document_id.description: Provenance: tracks which document and pipeline produced this attribute

source_pipeline.description: Pipeline that produced this spec: mistral-ocr, technical-drawing, cad-worker, manual

suggested_canonical.description: Suggested catalog attribute for unmatched specs

tolerance.description: Tolerance as written (e.g., "±0.1", "DIN ISO 2768-mk"); model-extract part-analysis

ucum_unit.description: UCUM unit derived from original_unit by spec-worker

value_type.description: Value type: scalar, range, vector, categorical, text

breakdown.description:
Breakdown lists the factors THIS class judges by (decisive first) —
different per category, replacing the legacy composite breakdown.

reason.description:
Reason is the class-specific explanation generated from the same
evidence as the verdict — it can never contradict the class chip.

score.description:
Score is the rule-derived similarity in [0,1]: the class fixes the band
(a product variant can never score like a duplicate) and the evidence
rows position the pair within it. Replaces the embedding/composite
percentage on the compare page for classified tenants.

status.description: match (identity-grade) | close (variant band) | diff | only_a | only_b | info

boms.description:
Unified search: BOMs / ERP files whose contained part numbers match the
query. The frontend renders these in a grouped layout alongside the
item results. Empty when Elasticsearch isn't configured or returns no
hits.

fit.description:
Two-stage compare (model_extraction tenant only): a SEPARATE additional score over the
other part measurements (surface roughness, material, weight, bending radius), computed
only when the important specs "fit". Deliberately NOT folded into WeightedTotal, so the
primary score/classification is identical for every tenant.

specs_within_tolerance.description: True if key specs (mass, dimensions) are within tolerance

mesh_url.description: Signed URL for GLB 3D mesh (JT or STEP medium LOD)

mesh_url_high.description: STEP high-detail LOD (only set for STEP)

mesh_url_low.description: STEP low-detail LOD (only set for STEP)

mesh_url_med.description: STEP medium-detail LOD (only set for STEP)

contains_synced.description: normal folder with synced folder(s) beneath it

shared_root.description: folder has an active shared-storage share (owner-side badge)

synced.description: item is a synced folder or inside one

path_shared.description: dir is a shared folder or inside one (owner badge)

aliases.description: Alternative names / aliases for this property

expiry_days.description: Number of days from now until the request expires (1-30, default 7)

response.description: Current response data (populated when a response exists).

request_id.description: UUID of the supplier data request

token.description: Short-lived JWT for accessing the request

status.description: "duplicate", "alternative", "rejected", or "pending" (resets to null in DB); with model_extraction also "interchangeable_variant", "superseded", "product_variant", "related_parts", "component_of"

cluster_id.description:
ClusterID is the lexicographically smallest item ID in the cluster,
giving a stable, deterministic identifier.

internal_code.description:
InternalCode is the drawing internal code (Kacher-test only), derived from
additional_data; shown as the small identifier line in the UI. db:"-" so pgx
never tries to scan a non-existent column.
drawing internal code (Kacher-test); small identifier line
drawing internal code (Kacher-test); shown as the small identifier line

reviewed_count.description: human-validated matches for this item (model_extraction; 0 otherwise)

columns.description: Columns contains the suggested column mapping.

confidence.description: Confidence is a value between 0 and 1 indicating how confident the AI is.

reasoning.description: Reasoning explains why the AI chose this classification.

suggested_levels.description:
SuggestedLevels contains the computed hierarchy levels for sample rows
when hierarchy_type is "teamcenter_traversal". Index aligns with sample_rows.

attributes.description:
Attributes holds every remaining ERP column (dynamic import): each
spreadsheet column that is NOT one of the first-class ERP fields above,
so it can be labeled by the AI, edited by the user, and preserved.

find_no_column.description:
FindNoColumn is the column containing Find Number (position within parent).

hierarchy_pattern.description:
